verdict: Leads are arriving at lower cost, but none are converting to booked appointments.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 122 leads at a cost per lead of $11.90 — a 26% improvement week-over-week, driven by a sharper pullback in spend than in lead volume. That efficiency gain is real, but it reflects reduced spend rather than stronger output. The more pressing issue is what happens after a lead arrives: 81 opportunities are sitting in the pipeline with zero converted and zero appointments booked, which points to a gap in how leads are being followed up, not a problem with the ads themselves. We're working to close that intake gap and repair attribution tracking so the August numbers can be fully validated ahead of the end-of-month review.
